digest.component_or_area: AWS Bedrock LLM provider (native pydantic-ai path)
propositions: Register a native bedrock builder in the provider factory that constructs pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel/BedrockProvider using the ambient AWS credential chain, rather than fronting Bedrock with an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
Prompt caching must set exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, rejecting bedrock_cache_messages.

Bedrock prompt caching is model-dependent and fails silently, billing full input tokens with no error, so rebar must warn when caching was requested but both cache_read and cache_write counters are zero.

temperature is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models, so add a supports_temperature capability and an exact-model-id override table to omit it, without altering closed story f184's signed override contract.

Add a provider-agnostic helper translating a 400/ValidationException naming a sampling parameter plus a rejection word into an LLMConfigError naming the model id, parameter, and remedies, while unrelated 400s remain LLMUnavailableError.

Ship boto3 behind a [bedrock] optional extra (added to dev) so [agents] install stays AWS-free, with the builder raising a clear missing-extra error and the live cache canary confined to tests/external/.
